lines.intro: A fizzy bat loops down from the crystals, squeaking like a tiny kettle!
lines.command: How can Fae calm the dizzy bat?

soothe.great: Fae hums a soft cave echo. The bat folds its wings and listens, ears perked!
soothe.good: Fae hums gently. The bat's wild loops slow to a dreamy flutter.
soothe.miss: The bat squeaks right over Fae's humming, spinning in circles.

play.great: Maddie leaps at a dancing crystal sparkle. The bat swoops after her, giggling!
play.good: Maddie wags her tail in the glow. The bat hovers low to peek.
play.miss: Maddie chases her own shadow. The bat zips back up to the ceiling.

cast.great: Sue twirls her glowing ribbon bobber. The bat tracks every swoop, charmed!
cast.good: Sue casts her bobber past the crystals. The bat tilts its fuzzy head.
cast.miss: Sue's bobber bumps a stalagmite. The bat puffs its cheeks and flaps away.

juggle.great: Jordan juggles three glowing pebbles. The bat beats its wings right in time!
juggle.good: Jordan tosses a sparkly stone high. The bat chirps and glides after it.
juggle.miss: Jordan's pebbles clatter across the cave floor. The bat flaps up in a tizzy.

lines.snack: Fae holds up a sweet fruit snack. The bat nibbles it mid-hover, happy!
lines.burst: The bat swoops low, kicking up a fizzy cave breeze!

burstResult.great: Fae leans right into the cave breeze and keeps her footing!
burstResult.good: Fae sways in the sparkly gust, then plants her sneakers.
burstResult.miss: WHOOSH! The cave breeze ruffles Fae's bangs and pushes her back.

lines.soothed: The bat lets out a cozy yawn and tucks its wings warm around its nose.
lines.rest: Fae is tuckered out from all that swirling air. Time for a rest.
lines.run: Fae tiptoes back toward the crystals. The bat swoops off into the rafters.
